newsitem.title: SPAIN: Private consumption up in early 1997 - Bank of Spain.
newsitem.headline: Private consumption up in early 1997 - Bank of Spain.

text.p: The Bank of Spain said household consumption improved in the first few months of the year.
"Available information on household consumption in the first months of 1997 confirms the improvement suggested in prior months," the Bank of Spain said in its March economic Bulletin.
The improvement was based on rising non-foodstuff purchases, "although foodstuff consumption also is beginning to show signs of recovery," the Bulletin said
The Bank of Spain underlined that a rise in consumer confidence in the last quarter of 1996 continued in the first two months of this year.
It also emphasised the favourable behaviour of prices in the first two months of this year.
"The latest indicators of published prices have behaved favourably," the report said, in line with its recent twice yearly report on inflation.
